To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the jet response (in particular the jet anisotropy coefficient) to harmonic fluctuations in the geometric initial state is a sensitive probe of the harmonic content of those fluctuations, and that a near-side jet correlation with the bulk matter flow is a robust consequence of the common response of both the bulk matter and the jet to the same harmonic fluctuations.

(1) the hard-soft correlation in the initial condition is a robust and narrow peak, (2) it is dominated by the common geometric fluctuations, and (3) the peak is sensitive to the jet quenching parameter.
(i) The hard–soft correlation arising from the common geometric fluctuations is dominated by the near-side peak.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the initial state of heavy ion collisions and the subsequent evolution of the medium created in these events.
the initial condition of high energy heavy ion collisions, particularly the fluctuations in the initial geometry.
the jet response to the geometric fluctuations of the initial condition in heavy ion collisions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, the near side peak of hard-soft correlation is a robust signal of the initial harmonic fluctuations, and the hard-soft correlation may provide a unique way to measure the harmonic fluctuation of the initial condition of the bulk expansion.
jet tomography of harmonic fluctuation is a powerful tool for understanding the initial condition of relativistic heavy ion collisions.
the jet tomography of the harmonic fluctuations is a powerful tool to constrain the properties of the initial condition of the hot QCD matter created in heavy ion collisions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the jet tomography of initial condition fluctuations is an effective way to study the initial geometry of heavy ion collisions.
jet tomography of the harmonic fluctuations is a powerful tool to extract the information about the initial condition of the bulk matter in the early stage of heavy ion collisions.
the jet response to the geometric fluctuations in the initial state is large and positive.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hard-soft correlation is a sensitive probe of the initial condition of a heavy ion collision.
the jet response to the initial condition is a powerful tool to constrain the initial condition of high energy heavy ion collisions.

, in contrast to the conventional wisdom that jet energy loss is the primary source of the near-side hard-ridge, it is in fact the geometric fluctuations of the initial condition that is responsible for this feature.
